summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks the supreme refuge and religion, and Bhishma answers by extolling Vishnu and beginning the recitation of His thousand names.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while the gathered kings and sages listen as he begins reciting the thousand names of Vishnu to Yudhishthira.
Yudhishthira stands with folded hands before the arrow-pierced Bhishma, asking who the one supreme God and refuge of the world is.
A cosmic vision of Vishnu with four arms holding conch, discus, mace, and lotus, radiating light as countless divine attributes are proclaimed.
